# TextAlignment

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Text alignment options for paragraph and text block elements.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Values

- `Left`: Text is aligned to the left edge
- `Center`: Text is centered horizontally
- `Right`: Text is aligned to the right edge
- `Middle`: Text is centered vertically (for vertical layout contexts)
- `Justify`: Text is justified to fill the full width (spreads words evenly)
- `Start`: Inline start, resolved using content direction.
- `End`: Inline end, resolved using content direction.
